steps.name: 1,2-dichloro-1,2-dihydro-3H-1λ3-benzo[d][1,2]iodazol-3-one S-2
steps.procedure: Procedure I (Optimized): A solution of {R:2-iodobenzamide S-1} (7.41 g, 30 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) in 25 mL {S:CH2Cl2} was cooled to {T:0 °C to RT}. {R:t-BuOCl} (6.51 g, 60 mmol, 2.0 equiv.) was added dropwise over 30 min. The mixture was allowed to warm to RT and stirred for {H:24 h} in the dark under air. The resulting precipitate was filtered, washed with cold petroleum ether (3 × 25 mL) and CH2Cl2 (10 mL), and dried under vacuum to give {P:1,2-dichloro-1,2-dihydro-3H-1λ3-benzo[d][1,2]iodazol-3-one S-2} (9.5 g) in {Y:97%} yield as a bright yellow crystalline solid.

steps.name: CFBI
steps.procedure: Procedure II (Optimized): Under an argon atmosphere, S-2 (2 g, 6.4 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) was placed in a 100 mL Schlenk flask and cooled to {T:-20 °C to RT}. Anhydrous {S:CH2Cl2} (50 mL) was added via cannula, followed by {R:AgF2} (2.88 g, 20 mmol, 3.1 equiv.) and {R:CsF} (0.97 g, 6.4 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) as a co-activator. The mixture was stirred at -20 °C for 1 h, then warmed to RT over {H:4 h}. The suspension was filtered through dry Celite under argon, and the filtrate was concentrated under reduced pressure to afford {P:CFBI} as a pale yellow solid in {Y:78%} yield.
